higher_thought.name: Higher Thought
higher_thought.tagline: Tech Troubleshooting, Electronics Repair & AI Setups
higher_thought.hours: Open for calls 24/7 - the front desk answers day and night
services: Tech Troubleshooting & Setup: Free diagnostic look - exact quote after seeing the setup (computers, phones, Wi-Fi, smart home)
Electronics Repair & Soldering: Free diagnostic look - exact quote after inspection (circuit boards, charge ports, e-bikes & scooters, consoles)
Custom 3D Printing: Quoted per job after seeing the part or design (replacement parts, prototypes, one-offs)
AI Front Desk Setup for Local Shops: Quoted after a walkthrough (an AI receptionist that answers, books, and captures leads 24/7 - like this one)
higher_thought.policies: Drop-off only, by appointment (AI setups are the exception - those are installed at the client's shop). The diagnostic look is always free: you get an exact quote only after we have seen the job, never a guess sight-unseen. Workmanship guarantee: if a repair fails because of our work, we fix it free. To book a drop-off or a quote, leave your name and phone number and the owner will text you back. Payment is due upfront by Zelle or Cash App once you approve the quote.
